name: logo-material-explorer
title_zh: 平面 Logo 变立体材质，品牌特征一条不丢
tagline_zh: 把扁平的 Logo、字标、花押送进三维空间，试挤塑厚度、换表面材质。自带参考材质库。
tagline_en: Extrude wordmarks, monograms, brand marks into 3D. Try bevel depths, map surfaces from your own or built-in.
desc_en: Use when a user wants to turn a flat logo, wordmark, monogram, or brand mark into a dimensional 3D material study, compare extrusion geometry, or apply a supplied or built-in surface reference while preserving brand identity.
why_zh: 不是简单拉个厚度，而是把品牌识别当作硬约束：几何比例、负空间、笔画关系在挤压和贴材质后仍可辨认。
why_en: It treats brand identity as a hard constraint, not an afterthought. Proportions, counters, and stroke relationships survive.
limit_zh: 只吃扁平矢量或高对比单色图；不生成新 Logo、不重绘细节，只做几何挤出和材质映射。输出为三维场景预览。
limit_en: Input must be flat vector or high-contrast monochrome. No logo redrawing or detail recovery. Output is a 3D scene preview only—no rendered stills or.
title_en: Turn flat logos into dimensional material studies, brand.
